Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a two-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, when the front of the vehicle struck the
front of a second vehicle operated by Driver 2, which had crossed into the same lane. The impact was low speed, and
both vehicles came to rest at the point of contact. Driver 1 remained seated on arrival of the first responding unit and
reported pain in the lower back. A Passenger was also present in the vehicle and was seen and accounted for at the
scene. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave the
same account. Photographs taken at the scene show front-end damage to both vehicles that is consistent with the
reported impact. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering the vehicle. Officers found no indication of
prior damage to the vehicle. The reported back complaint is consistent with the kind and force of a frontal impact of
this nature. No citations were issued at the scene.
